Messages.Author: bswai...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
A few questions:

Society of Leopold:

Can a Vampire with Society of Leopold and 0 blood choose to burn one
blood (with no effect) or is the Vampire automatically burned?

Antoinette DuChamp:

Does she have to pay an extra blood for Celerity cards that grant
extra-strikes? Or is it just strike cards (like Fast-Hands? Anything else?).

Hidden Lurker:

Can you play Hidden Lurker after playing a Change of Target?

Sent via Deja.com
http://www.deja.com/

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <93q0e2$mlq$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

bswai...@my-deja.com wrote:
> Society of Leopold:
> Can a Vampire with Society of Leopold and 0 blood choose to burn one
> blood (with no effect)

No.

> or is the Vampire automatically burned?

The vampire is burned by the Society of Leopold.

> Antoinette DuChamp:
> Does she have to pay an extra blood for Celerity cards that grant
> extra-strikes?

No.

> Or is it just strike cards (like Fast-Hands? Anything else?).

Just strike cards, for example any Strike: Dodge that requires celerity.

> Hidden Lurker:
> Can you play Hidden Lurker after playing a Change of Target?

No.
Hidden Lurker requires that a combat occur between an acting
minion and defending minion before it can be played. Change
of Target cancels the action and the combat, so no combat occurs.

See the online card texts here:

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Checklist_VTES.html

Change of Target [Jyhad, V:TES]
Cardtype: Action modifier
Only usable when this acting minion is blocked. Untap the acting
{minion, do not tap the blocking minion}, and cancel the current action
and combat. If you do a second action with this minion this turn, it
cannot be the same action

Hidden Lurker [Jyhad, V:TES, SW]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Obfuscate
Usable only by an untapped vampire other than the acting minion after
the acting minion is blocked and combat is over. Tap this vampire. This
vampire now enters combat with the blocking minion. The first round of
combat, the blocking minion cannot use any strikes (not even the
default hand strike). (S) As above, but with an optional press.

Carpe Noctem.

Messages.Body:
The Lasombra <TheLa...@hotmail.com> wrote:
> bswai...@my-deja.com wrote:
> > Society of Leopold:
> > Can a Vampire with Society of Leopold and 0 blood choose to burn one
> > blood (with no effect)

> > or is the Vampire automatically burned?
>
> The vampire is burned by the Society of Leopold.

Correct. You must do one or the other. Failing to burn a blood
doesn't qualify as burning a blood.

> > Antoinette DuChamp:
> > Does she have to pay an extra blood for Celerity cards that grant
> > extra-strikes?
>
> No.

Correct.

> > Or is it just strike cards (like Fast-Hands? Anything else?).
>
> Just strike cards, for example any Strike: Dodge that requires
> celerity.

Correct.

> > Hidden Lurker:
> > Can you play Hidden Lurker after playing a Change of Target?
>
> No.

Correct.

> Hidden Lurker requires that a combat occur between an acting
> minion and defending minion before it can be played. Change
> of Target cancels the action and the combat, so no combat occurs.

It actually requires combat between the acting minion and a
blodking minion.
